items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names reveal intent (buildWindowSpec, validateWindowName, windowSql). Each .window() has a JSDoc block, and the formatting matches the codebase after the dprint fix. Loop variables `w`/`i` are only iteration variables.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The same manual comma-joining loop (`if (i < windows.length - 1) windowChunks.push(sql`, `)`) is copied into all five dialects instead of `sql.join(chunks, sql`, `)`. The proxy-resolution code in .window() is also copied five times.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: All required checks are present and tested: ntile/nthValue reject non-positive integers, preceding/following reject negative or non-integer values (NaN and Infinity too), frames reject from after to, and window names reject empty and whitespace-only values. No errors are swallowed.

items.name: Public API additions are additive and consistent across dialects
items.name_zh: 公共 API 新增保持向后兼容且各方言一致
items.evidence: Purely additive: an optional `windows?: { name; spec }[]` field on every *SelectConfig, and an identical .window() on pg/mysql/sqlite/singlestore/gel. windowSql is undefined when unused, so existing SQL is unchanged, and all P2P tests pass.
